title: Scrollable
description: x-scrollable makes its host scroll on the axes direction names, capped at maxHeight and maxWidth.

direction.description: Which axes scroll: vertical, horizontal or both. Any other value adds no scrolling.

maxHeight.description: Largest height before the content scrolls vertically, as any CSS length. Used by vertical and both.

maxWidth.description: Largest width before the content scrolls horizontally, as any CSS length. Used by horizontal and both.

setup: Wide content that scrolls sideways

_metadata.derivedFrom: layouts.js scrollable() — every property here is one the behavior reads
